main_text.p: bus, quæ cives suos, pecudes facit, & bubulcum mavult agere, quam Principem: Principem ego mihi serium totum, syncerum totum, suspiciente imaginatione repræsento, & velut humani conventus sanctissimum aliquem gravissimumque præsulem: Fugiant! Fugiant! Machiavelli noctuæ, ad illustrem hanc & pulcerrimam boni Principis ideam. Nunc purgationi, Pantomime, respondebo tuæ: Plebem decepisse te fateris; non Philosophos? Imo, inquam, Philosophos decepisti, non plebem. In Scholis montes tuarum fraudum; in triviis verucæ tantum; Vin' tibi

page.notes: Left margin contains cut-off fragments of text from the adjoining page, not transcribed. The first line is a continuation of a sentence begun on the previous page. Some words in the first column are uncertain (e.g. "serium", "verucæ") and read as printed. "Vin' tibi" is a catchword-like line set at the right; treated as the last printed line of the text.
